our_constraints.cloud_compute: Modal for container sandboxes (no local Docker allowed)
our_constraints.human_availability: Unattended overnight execution (~8 hours during human sleep)

DBOS.behavior: Completed steps returned from SQLite step journal; only interrupted in-flight steps re-ran

Temporal.qualifier: At-least-once: runs twice if agent process dies with worker per VF-F-WORKFLOWS S3; exactly-once if agent outlives worker
Temporal.behavior: Completed activities not re-executed; in-flight re-attaches or retries

Dagu.behavior: Zombie detector caught runner termination within 2s; completed steps not re-run

Baseline.behavior: 16 duplicate executions; restarts entire squad from scratch; effects exact-1 only due to fixture idempotency

Dagu.behavior: human.task file state survives engine reboot & downtime; 1 exec PREP, 1 exec DEPLOY

scorecard_summary.Temporal: 4/5 (3 pass + 1 loud fail, 1 native FAIL on KT3)
scorecard_summary.Dagu: 4/5 (3 pass + 1 recover, 1 native FAIL on KT3)

DBOS.one_sentence_pick: Primary pick for single-host Python overnight squads: zero server daemons, zero network ports, sub-second startup, step-level journaling, and flawless native 0-attempt quota parking.

Temporal.network_ports: 6 loopback LISTEN sockets on dev server
Temporal.storage_backend: SQLite dev server (--db-filename); in-memory without it
Temporal.external_binaries: Downloads 216 MB Go binaries (150.8 MB server + 65.4 MB CLI)
Temporal.determinism_tax: Severe: workflow sandbox forbids time.time(), I/O, asyncio.wait(); blocking activities stall worker loop; dev server misses 5s startup window under machine load
Temporal.one_sentence_pick: Secondary / benchmark pick: choose only when scaling to distributed multi-machine agent clusters where centralized gRPC orchestration and enterprise tracing justify the heavy operational footprint and determinism tax.

Dagu.determinism_tax: Zero (pure shell commands), but static DAGs only (no dynamic fan-out/fan-in, string interpolation only, no Python state, no token/budget accounting)
Dagu.one_sentence_pick: Specialized pick: choose strictly for fixed-shape, scheduled CLI toolchains (nightly lint, static analysis, fixed-list benchmark sweeps) and operator approval forms that require a visual web UI.

Baseline.determinism_tax: Zero, but crashes lose all state, restarts re-run finished work (76 execs vs 60), detached workers (start_new_session=True) orphan on kill -9, high coordinator toil
Baseline.one_sentence_pick: Retire after Phase 0 hardening: suitable only for short throwaway runs where transient failure is negligible and re-running from scratch is acceptable.
